dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp, high-contrast outer perimeters with a rapid gradient transition from a dark dorsal background to a lighter, pigmented interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of small, solid high-intensity pixel groups are visible at the junctions where larger macro-annuli converge, particularly in the upper-left quadrant.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent macro-annuli in the upper-left and central regions form an irregular pentagonal spatial relationship.

other_distinctive_markers: The texture exhibits a complex, interconnected lattice where the boundaries of adjacent macro-annuli merge, creating a continuous reticulated mesh pattern.
